title: Woodland food web card sort
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Ecosystems (7D); atoms, elements and molecules (7H)
source: Seeded from science/y7 lesson 55 (Woodland food web card sort (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 55: Food chains and food webs. To understand how energy is transferred through food chains and webs

questions.q: Lettuce → slug → thrush → cat. Name the primary consumer and the carnivores.
questions.a: Primary consumer: slug. Carnivores: thrush and cat
questions.model: Count from the producer: lettuce is the producer, slug eats it (primary consumer). Thrush and cat eat animals: carnivores.

questions.q: Which way do the arrows point?
questions.a: From the eaten to the eater (the way energy moves)

questions.q: Build a food web from 8 woodland organisms on the sheet. Label each as producer, herbivore or carnivore.
questions.a: Correct web with producers at the bottom and arrows towards eaters
questions.model: Teacher places oak and grass at the bottom and adds the first arrow: oak leaves → caterpillar.

questions.q: Choose one organism. Predict what happens to two others if it disappears.
questions.a: A chain of reasoning using the web

questions.q: Why are top predators often the first to suffer when an ecosystem is damaged?
questions.a: They depend on many levels below; less energy reaches them

questions.q: An animal that eats only plants is a...
Big question: where does all the energy in your breakfast come from?
